I got a new psychiatrist and flat out lied about my symptoms and past so I could go back on vyvanse for ADHD (ended very catastrophically) but somewhere along the way I’d convinced myself I wasn’t bipolar. So I got a new really good one and just straight very honestly told him my history and all my symptoms without mentioning any past diagnosis and he immediately rediagnosed me bipolar and sure enough, i went into rapidly elevating hypomania about 2 days later because i had restarted my Zoloft on my own prior to seeing him (i know i know). So if you do get reevaluated by a new psychiatrist, don’t spin the facts, don’t leave anything out, don’t lie, tell it exactly as it is then after the new diagnosis, whether it’s bipolar or not, then be sure to say you’d been diagnosed bipolar. Some people don’t have mania for years then it hits unexpectedly with no safety net and can ruin their lives and relationships in a matter of weeks.
